featured_reviews.name: Mihir Nagda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience at Circle Tattoo! My friend and I went in for matching minimal tattoos on our forearms, and everything from start to finish was handled so smoothly. The studio felt clean and professional, and it was reassuring to see that all the equipment used was brand new and properly sealed.

The artist was extremely sweet-spoken, patient, and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Even though it was a small, minimal design, they paid close attention to detail and placement, which really shows in the final result. The whole process took less than 20 minutes, but it never felt rushed.

We absolutely loved how our tattoos turned out—clean, precise, and exactly what we wanted. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for minimal or fine line tattoos done professionally!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words. We’re really glad you and your friend had a smooth and comfortable experience. Looking forward to having you both back again.

I recently got my nose piercing done at Being Animal Tattoos, and the entire process was very smooth and comfortable. Everything went perfectly at first, but after two days, it accidentally came out and I couldn’t reinsert it no matter how much I tried. I honestly gave up at one point.

That’s when I reached out to Mr. Sachin, and he responded very quickly and asked me to visit the studio. He handled the situation with so much patience and professionalism. Although it was a bit painful for me, he stayed calm, confident, and kept trying his best. Since the inner end wasn’t clearly visible, it took some time, but he managed it so well.

I’m truly grateful for his dedication and effort. This experience made me realize that I chose the right artist. Highly professional, skilled, and genuinely committed to his work. Highly recommend!
